question: Should exact proposal preview and optional proposal-version checking become part of the permanent core Skill Workshop approval contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and preserves existing direct callers, but it adds a new model-facing and CLI action plus intentional fail-closed behavior for proposals revised during a pending approval; repository history cannot establish product acceptance for that permanent contract.

options.title: Adopt optional binding
options.body: Land the canonical preview and optional proposal-version guard while retaining all existing proposal-ID-only lifecycle calls.

options.title: Preview without binding
options.body: Land the read-only exact preview but defer approval-time and lifecycle version binding to separate work.

options.title: Keep summary approvals
options.body: Decline the new action and retain inspect plus metadata-only approval descriptions.

recommendation.title: Adopt optional binding
recommendation.body: Land the canonical preview and optional proposal-version guard while retaining all existing proposal-ID-only lifecycle calls.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest broad history signal across the current Skill Workshop service and agent tool surface.
